description: Source code for a video decoder implementation using Chromium media GPU infrastructure, specifically for VDA (Video Decode Accelerator) on Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit platform. Contains class definitions, methods for initialization, decoding, buffer management, error handling, and platform-specific GPU interactions.

classes.name: VdaVideoDecoder
classes.description: Implements a video decoder using the Video Decode Accelerator (VDA) interface, managing initialization, decoding, buffer handling, error states, and platform-specific GPU interactions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new VdaVideoDecoder instance with specified configuration and capabilities.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with a given configuration, handling reinitialization if needed.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Submits a video buffer for decoding.

methods.name: ProvidePictureBuffers
methods.description: Provides picture buffers to the VDA for decoding output.

methods.name: DismissPictureBuffer
methods.description: Dismisses a picture buffer by ID.

methods.name: PictureReady
methods.description: Handles a decoded picture ready for output.

methods.name: NotifyEndOfBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Notifies that a bitstream buffer has been fully decoded.

methods.name: NotifyFlushDone
methods.description: Notifies that a flush operation has completed.

methods.name: NotifyResetDone
methods.description: Notifies that a reset operation has completed.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Handles an error reported by the VDA.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Reuses a picture buffer after display.

methods.name: EnterErrorState
methods.description: Transitions the decoder into an error state, rejecting further operations.

methods.name: DestroyCallbacks
methods.description: Cleans up callback states after an error.
